values.note: Power site C$30 a night; tent (non-power) site C$20; monthly C$750 power, C$500 non-power. GST included.

fees.source: Town of Bassano Bylaw 954-26 Municipal Fees, Rates and Charges https://bassano.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Bylaw-954-26-Municipal-Fees-Rates-and-Charges.docx (posted April 7, 2026 at https://bassano.ca/doc/bylaw-954-26-municipal-fees-rates-and-changes/; read 2026-11-11), 'Bassano Homecoming Campground' table: 'Open April 1 to October 15', 'Tent - Non Power Site $ 20', 'Monthly Non Power Site $ 500', 'Power Site $ 30', 'Monthly Power Site $ 750'; 'All fees, rates and charges contained include a Goods and Service Tax.'

sites.source: Town of Bassano Recreation & Leisure page https://bassano.ca/recreation-leisure/ (Community Hall section): 'adjacent to our municipal campground. The campground has 15 sites (with/without power)'; bylaw: 'includes full use and access of the Campground (15+ units ...)'

booking.source: Town of Bassano policy P-TOB72c/004-23 'Bassano Homecoming Campground - Rental Rates' https://bassano.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/P-TOB72-004-23-Bassano-Homecoming-Campground-Rental-Rates-Policy.pdf (approved April 11, 2023): 'The Campground is offered on a first come, first served basis.' 'The entire Campground may be reserved if all fees are paid in-full 60-days in advance of a function.'

note: Town of Bassano campground at 605 2nd Avenue, beside the Community Hall greenspace and the Kinsmen Park playground, a few blocks from the main street. The whole campground can be booked for a function with the hall. Open Wi-Fi at the Community Hall. --Claude
summary: Read the town's 2026 fees bylaw, its campground rental-rates policy and recreation page: power C$30, tent non-power C$20, monthly C$750/C$500 (GST in); open Apr 1 - Oct 15; FCFS (whole-campground function bookings only); 15 sites (stored 20). Booking reservable true -> false. Website page is an empty post; pin OK.

Google 'Bassano Homecoming Campground' 4.3 from 29 reviews, phone +1 403-641-3788 (the town office).
